primary_intent: Create and save a new Triage encounter for patient p1 with the exact note 'End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note,' saving it once and making no other changes. A reasonable user would not be flexible about the encounter actually being saved (committed); the note text and encounter type must be exact.
reasoning: Nitpicks: None — the agent used the correct app, opened patient p1, set Type to Triage, and entered the exact note. Critical issues: The encounter was not saved; a server non-response prevented the commit, so the primary deliverable (a saved encounter) is missing. Applying the Critical-Point rules for this task (permission granted to cross): this is FAILURE due to an environment blocker preventing the binding save from completing (no CP violation). Screenshot evidence shows 'The server did not answer. Try again later.' with no confirmation of a saved record. While the preliminary steps were correct and no extraneous changes were made, the outcome did not produce a committed encounter — the key thing the user wanted.

items.criterion: Use the clinic's record app as the platform
items.description: Navigate and operate within the specified clinic's record app to perform the task. Full credit if the app is used as specified, or if the app is inaccessible (errors, downtime, login wall, captcha) and the agent clearly reports the blocker. Partial credit if the agent immediately switches to an alternative system without first attempting the specified app when it was accessible. Using an alternative method is acceptable only if the clinic app is genuinely inaccessible or incapable of supporting the required action and this limitation is clearly stated.
items.justification: All actions occurred on http://clinic.example within the clinic’s record app; no alternate platforms were used. A server error was encountered and reported.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 of 1: The page UI clearly shows the clinic app interface with the header 'Encounter for patient p1', form fields, and a Save button. A pink error banner states 'The server did not answer. Try again later.'
items.post_image_justification: The clinic's record app was used as the platform, and the server error confirms an environment issue within the app. No alternate platform was used.

items.description: Locate and open patient 'p1' before adding the encounter. Full credit if the correct patient record is opened. Full credit also if 'p1' cannot be found after a reasonable search and the agent clearly reports non-existence/inaccessibility. If the app itself is inaccessible (as addressed in Criterion 1), do not penalize here.
items.justification: The initial state explicitly shows the new-encounter form for patient p1 is open, confirming the correct patient record was accessed.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 of 1: The header explicitly reads 'Encounter for patient p1'.
items.post_image_justification: This confirms the correct patient record (p1) was open when performing the task.

items.criterion: Create a new encounter with type 'Triage'
items.condition: Only if patient 'p1' is accessible/open in the clinic's app
items.description: Initiate adding a new encounter and select 'Triage' as the encounter type. Full credit if a new encounter is created and the type is explicitly set to 'Triage'. Full credit also if 'Triage' is not available or encounter creation is blocked by platform capabilities/permissions and the agent clearly reports this, OR if the closest equivalent encounter type (e.g., nurse triage/intake) is selected and the limitation is clearly explained. Partial credit if a new encounter is created but a different type is chosen when 'Triage' was available. No credit if no attempt to initiate a new encounter is made.
items.justification: On the new-encounter form for p1, the agent set the Type field to 'Triage', satisfying the requirement to create a Triage encounter.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 of 1: The form shows 'Type: Triage', indicating the encounter type is set to Triage.
items.post_image_justification: A new encounter form is open and the Type is correctly set to 'Triage'.

items.condition: Only if an encounter creation/edit screen with a notes or free-text field is accessible
items.description: Input the note text exactly as provided: End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note. Full credit if the saved note matches this phrase exactly (ignoring unavoidable platform-imposed formatting), or if entered into the most appropriate available free-text notes field when a dedicated 'note' field is absent. Full credit also if note entry is impossible due to platform limitations and the agent clearly reports this after attempting. No credit if the note differs materially (added/omitted words) or is left blank without a reported platform limitation.
items.justification: The agent entered the note exactly as provided into the Note field: "End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note."
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 of 1: The Note field contains the exact text 'End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note'.
items.post_image_justification: The exact provided note content was entered into the Note field.

items.criterion: Save the encounter exactly once (commit the record)
items.condition: Only if encounter creation/editing and save controls are available
items.description: Complete the save action to create the record, crossing the irreversible boundary as authorized. Full credit if the new Triage encounter is successfully saved with one save action (resulting in a single new encounter). Treat platform-driven autosave/versioning as acceptable if it results in a single committed encounter. Full credit also if saving is impossible due to platform limitations/permissions and the agent clearly reports this. Partial credit if save attempts face platform errors but are reported clearly, or if multiple save clicks were required due to validation/errors yet only one encounter is ultimately created. No credit if the encounter is not saved when saving was possible, or duplicate encounters are created without platform-forced cause.
items.justification: The agent clicked Save exactly once and encountered a server timeout (no reply within 0.6 s), an uncontrollable platform error, which was clearly reported in the final output.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 of 1: A pink banner states 'The server did not answer. Try again later.' The Save button and form remain visible; no success confirmation is shown.
items.post_image_justification: The agent clicked Save once and encountered a confirmed server non-response. Per uncontrollable blockers principle, award full credit for the save attempt and accurate reporting of the blocker.

items.criterion: Make no other changes beyond the requested action
items.description: Ensure no unrelated modifications are made to the patient record or other encounters beyond creating and saving the single Triage encounter with the specified note. Full credit if no other persisted changes occur (system-generated defaults/metadata, autosaves, or navigational clicks are acceptable). Partial credit if extraneous edits are initiated but not saved/persisted. No credit if any unrelated field or additional record is modified/saved.
items.justification: Only the Type and Note fields were filled and a single Save attempted; no unrelated fields or records were modified.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 of 1: Only the Type (set to Triage) and Note fields (with the specified text) are shown as changed; no other fields or records appear modified.
items.post_image_justification: No changes beyond setting Type and entering the specified note were made; a single Save attempt occurred.

side_effects.reasoning: No extraneous actions with material side effects occurred. The agent only filled the Type and Note fields as requested, attempted a single Save (which failed due to a server non-response), and made no additional edits or saves. There were no substitutions or unrelated records created. Thus, no unpenalized controllable failures are present.
